item.title: Siemens: Product Marketing Manager
item.skills: Data Analysis, Market Research, Product Marketing, Project Management, Social Media Marketing, and Branding
item.description:
Headquarters: Berlin, Germany
URL: http://www.siemens.com

Product Marketing Manager

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds, thereby improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

Transform the everyday with us!

We are looking for a Marketing Manager to develop and execute product marketing, branding, and digital strategies that strengthen market positioning, increase customer engagement, and support business growth. This is a remote position based in the United States.

You'll make an impact by:

  • Developing and executing product marketing and branding strategies for business-to-consumer and business-to-business audiences
  • Translating customer insights, market research, competitive intelligence, and industry trends into differentiated product positioning and go-to-market plans
  • Partnering with product management, marketing communications, design, and market-launch teams to communicate product features, benefits, and value propositions
  • Leading promotional and digital marketing strategies across channels such as social media, email marketing, and online advertising to increase awareness, engagement, lead generation, and sales
  • Providing creative direction for marketing content and promotional assets while maintaining consistency with brand standards across customer touchpoints
  • Establishing key performance indicators, evaluating campaign and marketing performance, and using data-driven insights to improve results and marketing effectiveness

You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications:

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field
  • 10 or more years of experience in marketing, product marketing, brand management, or a related field
  • Experience developing and executing marketing strategies, product-positioning plans, branding initiatives, and digital campaigns
  • Experience using customer, market, competitive, and campaign-performance data to guide marketing decisions
  • Demonstrated project management and cross-functional collaboration experience, including coordinating initiatives with product, communications, sales, or design teams
  • Ability to travel up to 10% for business meetings, customer engagements, and company events
  • Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master of Business Administration or another advanced degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
  • Experience marketing consumer goods, products, or solutions to both business-to-consumer and business-to-business audiences
  • Experience developing campaigns across social media, email marketing, online advertising, and other digital channels
  • Knowledge of branding principles, customer behavior, market segmentation, and contemporary digital marketing practices
  • Experience establishing marketing key performance indicators and using analytics to evaluate and optimize campaign performance
  • Experience applying agile planning practices to marketing launches or product-release activities

We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. item.title: Mitratech: Associate Product Marketing Manager – GRC
item.skills: Compliance, Data Analysis, Market Research, Product Marketing, Project Management, SaaS, Go-to-Market Strategy, and Sales Enablement
item.description:
Headquarters: Franklin Parish, Louisiana, United States
URL: http://www.mitratech.com

At Mitratech, we are a team of innovators focused on building world-class products that simplify operations in the Legal, Risk, Compliance, and HR functions. We are a close-knit, globally dispersed team that thrives in an ecosystem that supports individual excellence and takes pride in a diverse, inclusive culture centered on great people practices, learning opportunities, and fun! Our culture blends entrepreneurial spirit with enterprise investment, giving you the chance to move quickly with some of the most complex, leading-edge technologies available.

For over 35 years, the experts at Mitratech have been focused on solving the complex needs. Today, we serve 20,000 client companies of all sizes globally, representing 30% of the Fortune 500 and over 500,000 users in over 160 countries.

As we continue to grow, we’re always looking for resourceful, enthusiastic, and fresh perspectives. Join our global team and see what makes Mitratech a truly exceptional place to work!

This role is based in the US and operates as a key member of a globally distributed marketing team, collaborating closely with colleagues across the US, CAD, UK, and EMEA to deliver consistent, high-performing digital programs at scale.

Job Overview

The Associate Product Marketing Manager, GRC will support the go-to-market strategy and execution for select products in Mitratech's GRC portfolio. This role will focus on positioning and messaging, competitive intelligence, product launches, and sales enablement, working closely with Product Marketing, Product Management, Sales, Demand Generation, and Customer Marketing. We're looking for a hands-on marketer who can own defined projects, turn complex product and market information into clear, customer-facing messaging, and collaborate effectively across teams. The ideal candidate is curious, proactive, organized, and comfortable using data and AI tools to make marketing work more efficient.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Launch & GTM Execution

  • Support go-to-market activities for new products, capabilities, and feature releases.
  • Translate product updates into launch messaging, sales materials, presentations, and other customer-facing assets.
  • Coordinate with Product Management, Demand Generation, Customer Marketing, and Sales to support launch execution.
  • Support cross-sell and upsell initiatives by developing messaging and materials that help customers understand the value of additional products and capabilities.
  • Help ensure product positioning is consistently represented across relevant marketing and sales channels.

Sales Enablement

  • Develop and maintain sales enablement materials including buyer's guides, competitive guides, presentations, FAQs, objection-handling resources, and product messaging.
  • Manage the internal sales enablement tool and sales asset repository and act as primary administrator 
  • Support sales training and internal communications around new products, releases, positioning, and competitive insights.
  • Provide timely support for sales requests related to product messaging, competitive information, and deal-specific needs.

AI-Enabled Workflows

  • Use AI tools to streamline research, competitive monitoring, content development, and other repetitive marketing workflows.
  • Help test, improve, and maintain AI-assisted workflows while ensuring outputs remain accurate and aligned with business needs.
  • Come up with new ways to use AI in the PMM lifecycle and build skills and agents to assist

Competitive Intelligence & Win/Loss

  • Monitor competitors, market trends, customer needs, and developments across the GRC landscape.
  • Support the development and ongoing maintenance of competitive battlecards and sales resources for assigned products.
  • Support win/loss analysis by organizing feedback and identifying trends.

Requirements & Skills: 

  • 2-3 years of relevant experience in product marketing, B2B technology, SaaS, risk, compliance, or a related field.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Marketing, or Customer teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex products and concepts for different audiences.
  • Experience creating marketing and sales enablement materials for B2B audiences.
  • Comfortable conducting market and competitive research and turning findings into practical insights and assets.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Comfortable working with marketing or business metrics and using data to inform decisions. 
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve research, content creation, analysis, or marketing workflows.
  • Experience in GRC, risk, compliance, cybersecurity, legal technology, or enterprise SaaS is an asset.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field is an asset.

What Success Looks Like Within the first 6–12 months, you will:

  • Develop a strong understanding of Mitratech's GRC portfolio, customers, personas, and competitive landscape.
  • Become a reliable partner to Product Management and Sales on product messaging and go-to-market execution for assigned products.
  • Deliver high-quality positioning, launch, competitive, and sales enablement materials with increasing independence.
  • Contribute meaningful competitive and win/loss insights that improve messaging and sales effectiveness.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to make Product Marketing workflows more efficient.
  • Build strong relationships across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer teams. 

This role can be performed 100% remote anywhere in the US. Given the need for team collaboration and meeting overlap, candidates who can align with Eastern Time Zone business hours are strongly preferred. Anticipated Pay Range: 70,000-80,000 USD Annually. 

Mitratech is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity at all levels. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, gender, national or ethnic origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, family status, disability, or veteran status. Mitratech will work with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process. Please email recruiting@example.com to request an accommodation.

With services from facility maintenance and janitorial to landscaping and snow removal, we enable desired outcomes for our clients through consistent service and outstanding people. 

We are seeking an initiative-taking and experienced Proposal Writer. As the Proposal Writer, you will play a crucial role in crafting compelling proposals that highlight our company's capabilities and expertise to potential clients. Your ability to synthesize complex information, tailor content, and communicate value propositions effectively will directly contribute to our success in securing new business opportunities.

This is a 100% remote role but must reside in the central or eastern time zones.

Responsibilities:

Proposal Development:

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, subject matter experts, and management, to gather necessary information for proposal content.

• Translate technical and business information into clear, persuasive, and client-focused language.

• Minimum 3 years proposal writing experience

Content Creation:

• Write and edit proposal content, including executive summaries, project descriptions, methodologies, timelines, budgets, and other relevant sections.

• Ensure that proposals are tailored to the specific needs and requirements of each client or project.

Strategic Messaging:

• Develop a deep understanding of client pain points, objectives, and industry trends to craft persuasive value propositions.

Formatting and Design:

Research and Analysis:

• Conduct research to gather relevant data, statistics, case studies, and market insights to support proposal arguments.

• Analyze client needs and competition to formulate effective proposal strategies.

Deadline Management:

• Prioritize and manage multiple proposal projects simultaneously, adhering to tight deadlines.

• Coordinate with team members to ensure timely completion of all proposal components.

Knowledge Management:

• Maintain a repository of proposal content, templates, case studies, and references for future use.

• Continuously update and refine content based on feedback and industry changes.

Collaboration and Communication:

• Foster open communication with internal stakeholders to gather accurate and up-to-date information.

• Participate in meetings and discussions to understand project requirements and client expectations.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Marketing, Business, or a related field.

• Proven experience as a Proposal Writer or in a similar role.

• Experience with facility services industry. 

• Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills.

• Excellent attention to detail and ability to synthesize complex information.

• Familiarity with proposal formatting and design best practices.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

• Ability to work well under pressure and meet strict deadlines.

• Strong organizational and project management skills.

• Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

• Familiarity with proposal software or tools is a plus.

Benefits

• 100% Remote in the Central or Eastern Time Zones only.

item.title: Elavate: UGC Coordinator
item.skills: Data Analysis, Project Management, Storyboarding, and Negotiation
item.description:
Headquarters:
URL: https://elavate.teamtailor.com

About Elavate

Elavate is a multi-collagen supplement brand for women 40+, built around the changes that come with perimenopause and menopause. Our founder, Alex Philip, started it after getting fed up buying overpriced, low-quality, bad-tasting collagen for his mum.

Since launching in 2024 we've become one of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the UK, with over 35,000 five-star reviews. We launched in the US in 2026, and it's now our biggest focus for growth.

Our growth runs on video ads: UGC, influencer and celebrity talent content, made with an in-house team of creative strategists and video editors. The better the creators and the content, the faster we grow. That's where you come in.

The role

Our creative strategists write the scripts and our editors turn footage into ads. You're the person in the middle who makes the content happen: finding the right creators, briefing and storyboarding every script, running influencer and high-production shoots with our agency partners, and making sure every video that comes back is right.

You'll handle two kinds of content:

  • UGC: creators film themselves at home from our briefs, so the brief has to do all the directing

  • Influencer and high-production shoots: the two go hand in hand. We film well-known influencers and TV personalities with a professional crew, at a location picked for the look, with lighting, a teleprompter and make-up. These shoots make our long-form direct response ads, plus the hooks, product shots and B-roll that go with them

You'll work across both markets, the UK and the US, alongside our founder and creative team.

This is a communications, creators and systems role. You want to be in it every day: talking to creators, getting content made and getting deals done. Strategy experience is a plus, not a requirement.

What you'll own

Find and sign the best creators in the UK and US

  • Source new UGC creators every week, mostly women 40+ who come across as natural, expressive and believable on camera

  • Vet properly before anyone gets a brief: watch their content, judge their delivery, setting and camera skills, and only put forward people you'd bet on

  • Get in touch fast and keep every conversation moving. The best creators get booked up quickly, so speed wins the deal

  • Negotiate good deals: strong rates, the right usage and whitelisting terms, and every deliverable written in (videos, hooks, raw files, B-roll)

  • Keep the pipeline full so our strategists never wait on talent

Build and run our creator database

  • Build a database of the best UGC creators in the UK and US, and keep it up to date every week

  • Log every creator after every job: contact details, rates, niche, past jobs, how their content performed, delivery quality and whether we'd rebook them

  • Keep a bench of proven creators we can rebook at short notice

  • Keep an eye on creative performance in Motion, so you know which creators and videos are winning and can find, rebook and brief more like them

  • Run product sendouts: get product out as soon as a deal is signed and confirm it's arrived

Brief and storyboard every script

  • Turn finished scripts from our strategists into briefs a creator can film without guessing: a scene-by-scene storyboard, B-roll, visual direction, setting, outfits and props

  • Lock every brief before it goes out: one final version, a clear deadline, a reference video and links you've tested

  • Run a quick test clip before each full batch, so problems get caught before they cost us a refilm

Coordinate our influencer and high-production shoots

  • Work hand in hand with our content agency and shoot production agency: they run the day-to-day logistics on our crewed shoots, you make sure nothing gets missed

  • Run the threads with agents and talent managers on scheduling, call times and riders

  • Own the details: locations, props, product on set and a checklist to the crew before every shoot

Check content and get it live

  • Check every delivery against the script within 24 hours of filming: every hook, every section, resolution, lighting, framing and product shots

  • Post a written verdict for the team on what's good and exactly what's wrong (a thumbs-up isn't a check), so refilm calls get made fast

  • Once content is approved, get sign-off from the talent side, secure whitelisting access and hand clean files to our editors

How we work (read this part properly)

This is what makes or breaks the role, so we're being specific.

  • You're very responsive and active on Slack. This is one of the most important parts of the role. When you're online, messages get a reply in minutes, not hours, even if it's just "on it, back to you by 4pm". Slow replies are how things slip and shoots go wrong.

  • You own it end to end. Some of our shoots cost thousands, so you treat every one like it's your own money. Nobody checks behind you: if something's about to fall through the cracks, you catch it first.

  • You confirm, you don't assume. A CC isn't a confirmation. When a time, location or script changes, you confirm it directly with every person involved.

  • You take in the full context. You listen to the whole voice note, watch the whole Loom and read the whole thread before you act. Then you ask the questions that matter.

  • You close loops. Sign-offs, follow-ups and tracker updates don't sit with you. If something's blocked, you flag it before anyone has to chase you.

  • You turn up. Every call, on time and prepared.

  • You ship, then improve. A solid brief out today beats a beautiful one next week.

  • You build systems. If you're doing the same manual task twice, you build a workflow for it (Notion, templates, AI) so the third time is faster.

  • You're there when it's live. On shoot days and urgent threads, you jump online outside your normal hours if something needs doing.

  • You take feedback well. Direct feedback, no ego, acted on the same day.

Who you are

Must-haves

  • 2+ years in UGC, creator or influencer coordination, at a DTC brand, a UGC or performance creative agency, or an influencer or talent agency

  • Fluent written and spoken English: you'll talk to UK and US creators, agents and talent managers all day, so your messages are quick, clear and polite

  • You can read a video script and storyboard it scene by scene, with B-roll and visual direction (we'll ask you to show us)

  • An eye for talent: you can tell from a creator's content whether they'll work in a direct response ad

  • A strong negotiator who enjoys the people side: you get good rates and the right terms, and creators still want to work with you again

  • You know performance marketing metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS), can read an ad account audit, and have used Motion or a similar tool to review creative performance

  • Confident in Frame.io and Notion

  • Seriously organised: calendars, trackers and checklists are your thing, and nothing gets lost with you

  • AI-first: you use tools like Claude and ChatGPT every day to work faster, and you know how to build simple workflows that save the team time

  • Sharp and quick: you pick things up first time and don't need to be shown twice

Nice to have

  • Creative strategy or direct response experience: writing scripts and hooks, or turning ad data into new concepts

  • Experience with health, wellness, beauty or supplement brands

  • You've coordinated crewed shoots or worked with talent agents and managers

  • You've built something of your own: a side business, a creator account or an agency

Pay, hours and perks

  • $30,000 USD a year (about $2,500 a month), full-time, as an independent contractor

  • 3-month review against clear goals, with a pay step-up when you hit them, plus clear pay tiers so you always know what the next level takes

  • Remote from Latin America, with core hours agreed before you start that overlap the UK afternoon and the US working day

  • 28 days paid time off a year

  • Work directly with our founder and senior creative team, on content with well-known UK and US talent

  • A path into creative strategy if that's where you want to grow

How to apply

Apply with your CV. In a short note or cover letter, tell us about the best creator you've ever found and why they worked. Start it with the word "storyboard" so we know you've read this far.

Our process:

  1. Screening call

  2. Interview

  3. Paid test task, based on the real job

  4. Final interview

We move fast. If this sounds like you, apply today.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/elavate-ugc-coordinator
